subject.title: refactor(qa): give coverage IDs one taxonomy owner

question: Should the QA taxonomy adopt this canonical ownership mapping and reduce `smoke-ci` from the prior broad category set to the ten categories directly exercised by the fixed smoke plan?
rationale: The parser and tests can prove internal consistency, but only QA owners can confirm that removing inherited scenario/profile claims reflects intended evidence policy rather than accidentally reducing required CI coverage.

options.title: Approve the evidence model
options.body: Accept unique feature ownership and the narrowed `smoke-ci` profile because the profile should represent only the fixed plan’s directly proved categories.

options.title: Retain broader smoke scope
options.body: Require a focused revision that preserves any categories maintainers still consider contractual smoke coverage and adds or maps executable proof for them.

recommendation.title: Approve the evidence model
recommendation.body: Accept unique feature ownership and the narrowed `smoke-ci` profile because the profile should represent only the fixed plan’s directly proved categories.

likelyOwner.reason: The current member-authored change set and reconciliation rationale are concentrated in this QA taxonomy refactor.
